component.name: Dayhand
component.summary: Today's tasks, quick add and reminders

description.p: Dayhand shows what is overdue, what you work on now and what is planned for today. Add a task with a date at the end of the line ("Call the accountant fri 2pm"), tick tasks off, and get reminders as desktop notifications. It works offline and syncs with your own Dayhand server.
Task details with offline editing, labels, checklists and read-only repeat, reminder and link previews.
